authority: CEO evidence gate following JAYT-392 R2
purpose: Collect candidate first-party evidence only. This order authorizes no production, affiliate, alias, or destructive mutation.

requirements: Capture rendered HTML and PNG in one browser session under one capture_id.
Use UTF-8 Buffer byte offsets, not JavaScript character indices.
Determine the exact UTF-8 byte span of the selected container in the captured full HTML.
Each of offer, validity, Da Nang scope, and terms must have an exact UTF-8 quote wholly inside that container byte span.
The receipt must identify the selected container without fallback to an unrelated first candidate.
Write files, reread both HTML and PNG, and bind post-write sizes and SHA-256 hashes.

candidate_quotes.offer: Vào thứ 3 hàng tuần – Happy Day, giá vé CHỈ TỪ 45K
candidate_quotes.terms: Giá vé Happy Day không áp dụng vào các ngày Lễ/Tết

offer_artifact.required_container: A uniquely identified promotion detail container containing the U22 offer and eligibility terms.

validity_artifact.required_container: The exact U22 promotion card whose link resolves to the captured offer artifact.
validity_artifact.required_quote: An explicit date range covering 2026-09-11, or an unambiguous current-active statement for that exact linked U22 promotion.

venue_artifact.required_quote: An explicit official statement that identifies Metiz Cinema at Helio Center, Da Nang. A telephone area code, legal-jurisdiction clause, or inference is not sufficient.

binding_requirements: All three artifacts must be captured from the metiz.vn first-party origin in one collector run and have individual capture IDs, timestamps, byte hashes, and screenshots.
The validity card must contain the exact offer URL or an exact canonical identifier linking it to the offer artifact.
The relational receipt must record the actual URL relation, hashes of all three artifacts, brand_id METIZ_CINEMA, and all container byte spans.
No generic footer, hotline, legal clause, or separate unrelated page may substitute for an explicit venue quote.
No field may be labelled PASS or VERIFIED; use SUBMITTED_CANDIDATE_FOR_CEO_AUDIT.
